decision_notes: National legislature/chamber identity cross-checked against the institution, Wikidata and the primary IPU profile where accessible. This is separate from media and rights evidence. Primary evidence: https://data.ipu.org/parliament/BR/BR-UC01/

Official TV Senado page embeds its designated on-air provider. On-air TV and a retained channel recording play, but sampled output includes non-plenary programming; this validates the parliamentary broadcaster, not a currently live chamber or its eight parallel slots.

Source conditions: The broad reproduction summary is limited by the specific TV Senado terms: no commercial/advertising or political/ideological use; preserve logo/credits/context; third-party transfer and some uses need authorization. Third-party footage may be cleared only for the broadcaster. Retain official link-out; no unrestricted redistribution grant is inferred.
